senses.gloss: शमर (in रोम-श्˚), prob. = विवर, GopBr.
सम्-अर &c. See सम्-√ ऋ, p. 1170.
सम्-अर॑ m. (or n. g. अर्धर्चादी) coming together, meeting, concourse, confluence, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.
(ifc. f(आ). ) hostile encounter, conflict, struggle, war, battle with (सह), ŚāṅkhBr.; MBh. &c.
N. of a king of the Vidyā-dharas, Kathās.
of a king of Kāmpilya, Hariv.
of a brother of king Avantivarman, Rājat.
सामर mfn. with the immortals, accompanied by the gods, R.; BhP.
सम—रंहस् mfn. having equal impetuosity or speed, MW.
सम—रज्जु f. equal or mean cord, mean or equated depth, Col.
सम—रञ्जित mfn. coloured equally, Hariv.
= सं-र्˚, tinged, coloured, MW.
सम—रत m. n. a partic. posture in sexual union, L.
सम्-आ-रत mfn. (√ रम्) ceased from, left off, desisted, ChUp.
सम—रथ m. N. of a king, BhP.
सम—रभ m. ‘eq˚-embrace’, a kind of coitus, MW.
सम—रस mfn. having eq˚ feelings (-त्व n.), KāśīKh.
सम—रस—त्व n.
सम—रसी-करण n. causing to have eq˚ feelings, ib.
सम—रूप mfn. of the same form, MW.
सम—रूप्य mfn. = समाद् आगतः, formerly in the possession of an honest man (cf. रूप्य), Pāṇ. iv, 3, 81, Sch.
सम—रेख mfn. forming an even line, straight, Śak.
सम—˚र्च (fr. सम + ऋच्) mfn. having the same number of verses, ŚāṅkhŚr.
सम्-˚अर्चा f. id., KāśīKh.
समार्थ w.r. for शम्˚, MBh.

सम्-अर्थ mf(आ)n. having a similar or suitable aim or object, having proper aim or force, very forcible or adequate, well answering or corresponding to, suitable or fit for (gen. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
very strong or powerful, competent, capable of, able to, a match for (gen. dat. loc. inf., or comp.; rarely acc. abl., or pr. p.; with वराङ्गनासु = ‘sexually potent’), Mn.; MBh. &c.
having the same sense or meaning (= तुल्यार्थ, एकार्थ), Pāṇ. i, 3, 42 &c.
connected in sense, having the same grammatical construction (= सम्बद्धार्थ), Pāṇ.; APrāt. &c.
सम्-अर्थ m. a word which has force or meaning, significant word, MW.
the construction or coherence of words in a significant sentence, ib.
सम्-अर्थ n. ability, competence (see -युक्त)
conception, intelligibility (see दुह्-स्˚)
समार्थक mfn. having the same sense, L.
सम्-˚अर्थक mfn. able to, capable of (inf.), Vet.
maintaining, establishing, proving, corroborating, Sāh.
सम्-˚अर्थक n. Amyris Agallocha (?), W.
समार्थिन् mfn. seeking or desiring equality, W.
seeking peace with (instr.), R. (perh. w.r. for शम्˚).
समार्ध-ग mfn. situated on the same side, VarYogay.
समार्ष mfn. descended from the same Ṛṣi, MBh.
सम्-मर्ष m. = मर्ष, patience, endurance, BhP.
सामर्ष mfn. having impatience or anger, impatient, indignant, wrathful, enraged at (प्रति), Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
समा˚र्बुद (˚मार्˚), n. 100 millions of years, MBh.
सम्-अर्घ mfn. cheap, VarBṛS.; Vas.
सम्-अर्चक mfn. worshipping, KāśīKh.
सम्-˚अर्चन n. (or f(आ). ) the act of worshipping, adoration, Pañcar.
सम्-˚अर्चित mfn. worshipped, adored, honoured, W.
सम्-अर्ण्ण See सम्-√ अर्द्, p. 1157.
सम्-अर्ण्ण mfn. pained, wounded &c., Pāṇ.; Vop.
asked, solicited, W.
सम्-अर्ति f. suffering loss or damage or misfortune (in अ॑-स्˚, perhaps w.r. for अ-समार्ति), TS.
सम्-अर्थ—तर mfn. more (or most) competent, capable &c., Pañcat.
सम्-अर्थ—ता f. (Sarvad.) ability, capability, competence (-तया, with gen., ‘by virtue of’)
sameness of meaning, force or signification (of words), MW.
सम्-अर्थ—त्व n. (Rājat.) ability, capability, competence (-तया, with gen., ‘by virtue of’)
sameness of meaning, force or signification (of words), MW.
सम्-अर्थ—पद-विधि m. N. of a gram. wk.
सम्-अर्थ—युक्त mfn. adequate to or qualified for (loc.), R.
सम्-अर्थन n. (or f(आ). ) reflection, deliberation, contemplation (˚नं-√ कृ, ‘to reflect, consider’), MBh.; Kathās.
reconciling differences, reconciliation, W.
objecting, objection, ib.
सम्-अर्थन (अम्), n. establishing, maintaining, corroboration, vindication, justification, Pratāp.; Kuval.
energy, force, ability, competence (आत्, with gen., ‘by virtue of’), MBh.
सम्-अर्थना (आ), f. persuasion, invitation, MBh.
insisting on what is impossible, Vop.
सम्-˚अर्थनीय mfn. to be determined or fixed or established, TPrāt., Sch.
सम्-अर्थित mfn. taken into consideration, considered, judged, regarded, held, R.; Vikr.
resolved, determined, R.
maintained, established, TPrāt., Sch.
able, capable, Kāv.
सम्-अर्थित—वत् mfn. one who has judged or considered &c., Pañcat.; Kathās.
सम्-अर्थ्य mfn. to be established or corroborated or justified, Sāh.

सामर्थ्य n. (fr. सम्-अर्थ) sameness of aim or object or meaning or signification, belonging or agreeing together (in aim, object &c.), adequacy, accordance, fitness, suitableness, Pat.; Hariv.; Suśr. &c.
the being entitled to, justification for (loc. or comp.), MBh.; R. &c.
ability to or capacity for (inf. dat. loc., or comp.; acc. with √ कृ, ‘to do one's utmost’; with √ भज्, ‘to take pains’, ‘exert one's self’), ib.
efficacy, power, strength, force (आत्, or -तस् or -योगात्, ‘through the force of circumstances’, ‘by reason of’, ‘in consequence of’, ‘on account of’, ‘as a matter of course’), ib.
the force or function or sense of a word, Kusum.
सम्-√ अर्द् Caus. -अर्दयति, to pain greatly, distress, wound, MBh.
सम्-अर्धक , ˚धन &c. See सम्-√ ऋध्, p. 1171, col. 1.
सम्-अर्धक mfn. (fr. Caus.) causing to prosper &c., granting or bestowing any advantage, L.
सम्-अर्पक , ˚पण &c. See सम्√ ऋ, p. 1170, col. 3.
सम्-अर्पक mfn. (fr. Caus.) furnishing, yielding (-ता f.), Śaṃk.; Sarvad.
स-मर्य᳙ mfn. (for सम्-अर्य॑ See सम्-√ ऋ) attended by many persons, frequented (as a sacrificial ceremony), RV.
attended by (his) followers (said of Indra), ib.
सम्-अर्य᳙ n. (for स-म्˚ See p. 1157, col. 1) concourse (of people assembled on festive occasions), crowd, multitude, RV.
an assembly, congregation, community, ib.
tumult of battle, ib.
समर्य Nom. P. ˚य॑ति, to long for battle or war, RV.
स-मर्याद mfn. bounded, limited, keeping within bounds or in the right course, correct, Vās.
respectful, MW.
contiguous, neighbouring, L.
स-मर्याद m. contiguity, vicinity, L.
स-मर्यादम् (अम्), ind. decisively, exactly, Bhartṛ.
सम्-√ अर्ह् Caus. -अर्हयति, to show honour, pay respect to, BhP.
सम्-अर्हण n. respect, reverence, a respectful gift (acc. with उप-√ हृ, नि-√ धा and Caus. of प्र-√ वृत्, ‘to show honour’ or ‘offer a gift of honour’), BhP.
स-मारक mfn. including the world of Māra, Buddh.

सम्-आ-√ रभ् Ā. -रभते (rarely P. ˚ति), to take in hand, undertake, begin, commence (with acc. or inf.; ind.p. -रभ्य with acc. = ‘beginning from’), TS. &c. &c.;
to try to get near to or propitiate, MBh.
सम्-आरब्ध mfn. taken in hand, undertaken, begun (also ‘begun to be built’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
one who has begun or commenced, MBh.
happened, occurred, R.
सम्-आरब्ध—तर mfn. more frequent, Nidānas.
सम्-˚आरभ्य mfn. (cf. above) to be undertaken or begun (superl. -तम), MBh.
सम्-आरम्भ m. undertaking, enterprise, MBh.; R. &c.
spirit of enterprise, MBh. v, 990
beginning, commencement, Śāntiś.
w.r. for समारम्भण, an unguent, Śak., Sch.
सम्-˚आरम्भण n. taking in hand, undertaking grasping, Kāv.
anointing (= सम्-आलम्भन), Śak., Sch.
सम्-˚आरम्भिन् mfn. (prob.) hung with, Cat.
सम्-आराण॑ See सम्-√ ऋ, p. 1170.
सम्-अ॑रण n. coming together, meeting, Nir.
conflict, strife, battle, war, RV.
सम्-आ-√ राध् Caus. -राधयति (mc. also Ā. ˚ते), to conciliate, propitiate, win over, MBh.; Pur.
सम्-आराधन n. conciliation, propitiation, gratification, Ragh.; Sarvad.
a means of propitiating or winning, Mālav.
सम्-आ-√ रुध् (only ind.p. रुध्य), to block up, obstruct, R.
सम्-आरुरुक्षु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to mount or ascend (acc.), Ragh.
सम्-आरूढ mfn. mounted or ridden by (instr.), MBh.; R.; Kathās.
one who has mounted or ascended, riding upon (acc. loc., or उपरि), fallen upon, entered on or in (acc.), ib.
one who has agreed upon (acc.), Mn. viii, 156
grown, increased, Ratnāv.
grown over, healed, Hariv.
सम्-आरोप m. (fr. Caus.) placing in or upon (loc.), KātyŚr., Sch.
stringing (a bow), Bālar.
transference to (loc.), attribution, Daśar.; Sāh.; Pratāp.
सम्-आरोपक mf(इका)n. making to grow or thrive, Divyāv.
सम्-˚आरोपण n. transference, transposition, change of position (esp. of the sacred fire), ĀśvŚr., Sch.
stringing (a bow), Bālar.
सम्-आरोपित mfn. caused to mount or ascend &c.
placed in or on (acc.), Veṇīs.
put forth, displayed, R.
सम्-आरोपित—कार्मुक mfn. one who has strung a bow, ib.
सम्-आरोपित—भार mfn. one on whom a burden has been placed, ib.
सम्-आरोपित—विक्रम mfn. one who has displayed valour, ib.
सम्-आरोह m. ascending, mounting, riding upon, W.
agreeing upon, ib.
सम्-˚आरो॑हण n. the act of mounting or ascending, ascent to (gen.), ŚBr.; Nir. &c.
growing (of the hair), MārkP.
changing the position of the sacred fire (symbolically), Siṃhās.
सम्-˚आरोहणीया f. pl. N. of partic. verses, ŚāṅkhŚr.
स-मार्गण mfn. furnished with arrows, MBh.
स-मार्गण—गुण mfn. furnished with arrows and a bowstring, ib.
स-मार्दव mfn. having softness, with softness, together with leniency, Yājñ.
सम्-अर—कर्मन् n. the action of battle or war, R.
सम्-अर—कातर m. ‘timid in battle’, N. of a general, Kautukas.
सम्-अर—काम-दीपिका f. N. of wk.
सम्-अर—क्षिति f. field of b˚, R.
सम्-अर—जम्बुक m. ‘b˚-jackal’, N. of a man, Kautukas.
सम्-अर—जित् m. ‘victorious in b˚’, N. of a king (Kathās.)
सम्-अर—ं-जय m. ‘victorious in b˚’, N. of a king (Cat.)
सम्-अर—तुङ्ग m. ‘eminent in b˚’, N. of warrior, Kathās.
सम्-अर—बल m. ‘battle-force’, N. of warrior, Kathās.
सम्-अर—भट m. ‘battle-soldier’, N. of warrior, Kathās.
सम्-अर—पुंगव m. (with दीक्षित) N. of an author, Cat.
सम्-अर—भू f. field of b˚, Vās.
सम्-अर—भूमि f. field of b˚, Vās.
सम्-अर—मनोहरी f. N. of an astron. wk.
सम्-अर—मर्दन m. ‘destroying in b˚’, N. of Śiva, MBh.
सम्-अर—मूर्धन् m. the front or van of b˚, R.
सम्-अर—वर्मन् m. N. of a king, Rājat.
सम्-अर—वसुधा f. (= -भू), Inscr.
सम्-अर—विजय m. N. of a ch. of the Rudra-yāmala
सम्-अर—विजयिन् mfn. victorious in b˚, Bhartṛ.
सम्-अर—वीर m. ‘b˚-hero’, N. of the father of Yaśo-dā, W.
सम्-अर—व्यसनिन् mfn. fond of war, Mṛcch., Introd.
सम्-अर—शिरस् n. (= -मूर्धन्), Kāv.; Kathās.
सम्-अर—शूर m. a hero in battle, VarBṛS.
सम्-अर—सार m. n. N. of wk. (containing prognostics of success or defeat in warfare; also -संग्रह, m.)
सम्-अर—सार—संग्रह m. N. of wk.
सम्-अर—सिंह m. ‘b˚-lion’, N. of an astronomer, Cat.
सम्-अर—सीमन् m. f. battlefield, Bālar.
सम्-अर—स्वामिन् m. N. of an image or idol set up by Samara-varman, Rājat.
सम्-अ˚राख्य m. (in music) a kind of time
सम्-अ˚रागम m. outbreak of war, VarBṛS.
सम्-अ˚राग्र n. the front of b˚, R.
सम्-अ˚राङ्गण n. b˚ field
सम्-अ˚राङ्गन n. b˚ field (Kathās.)
सम्-अ˚राजिर n. b˚ field (Śiś.)
सम्-अ˚रातिथि m. ‘b˚-comer’, any one encountered in battle, Hariv.
सम्-अ˚रोचित mfn. fit for b˚ (as an elephant), L.
सम्-अ˚रोत्सव m. the festival or joy of b˚, Kathās.
सम्-अ˚रोद्देश m. battle-field, MBh.
सम्-अ˚रोद्यत mfn. prepared for battle or war, MW.
सम्-अ˚रोपाय m. stratagem of war,VarYogay.
सम्-अर्पक—ता f.
सम्-अ॑र्पण n. the act of placing or throwing upon, ŚBr.
delivering or handing completely over, consigning, presenting, imparting, bestowing (cf. आत्म-स्˚), R.; Kathās.; BhP.
making known, communicating, Śaṃk.; Sarvad.
(in dram.) angry invective between personages in a play (one of the 7 scenes which constitute a Bhāṇikā q.v.), Sāh.
सम्-˚अर्पणीय mfn. to be delivered or handed over or entrusted, Kād.
सम्-˚अर्पयितव्य mfn. id., Hit.
सम्-˚अर्पयितृ mfn. one who hands over or bestows or imparts (gen. or comp.), MBh.; Hariv.
सम्-˚अर्पित mfn. thrown or hurled at &c. &c. (see Caus.)
placed or fixed in or on, made over or consigned to (loc. or comp.), ŚBr. &c. &c.
restored, Hit.
filled with, Lalit.
सम्-˚अर्पित—वत् mfn. one who has consigned or delivered over, MW.
सम्-˚अर्प्य mfn. to be handed over or consigned, Pañcar.
सम्-अर्य—जि॑त् mfn. victorious in war or b˚, RV.
सम्-अर्य—रा॑ज्य n. the region occupied by a concourse (such as the above), ib.
सम्-˚अर्धन mf(ई)n. causing to prosper or succeed, ŚāṅkhŚr.
सम्-˚अर्धयितृ mf(त्री)n. one who fulfils, fulfiller, bestower, ĀśvGṛ.; ChUp.
सम्-अर्धुक mfn. prospering, succeeding, TS.
= सम्-अर्धक, L.
सम्-अर्धुका (आ), f. a daughter, L.
सम्-मर्द , ˚दन &c. See सम्√ मृद्, p. 1185, col. 1.
सम्-मर्द m. pressing or rubbing together, friction, pressure, Pratāp.
trampling, MBh.; R. &c.
impact (of waves), Rājat.
meeting, encounter (esp. with enemies), war, battle, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सम्-मर्शन , ˚शिन्. See सम्√ मृश्, p. 1181, col. 1.
सम्-म॑र्शन n. stroking, ŚBr.; ŚrS.
सम्-मार्ग , सम्-मार्जक &c. See सम्-√ मृज्., p. 1181, col. 1.
सम्-मार्ग m. wiping off, cleansing, Kum.; TBr., Sch.
a wisp of grass (for tying faggots together), ŚrS.
सम्-मार्जक mfn. sweeping, cleansing, a sweeper, Kull. on Mn. vii, 126
= बहु-ध॑न्यार्जक, L.
सम्-मार्जक m. a broom, L.
सम्-˚मा॑र्जन n. the act of sweeping or cleansing thoroughly, cleansing, scouring, purifying, brushing, ŚrS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
the anointing and washing (of images &c.), MW.
a wisp (or bunch of Darbha grass for purifying ladles &c.), TBr.; KātyŚr.
remains of food wiped off from dishes &c., MārkP.
a wisp or broom (made of tough grass and stalks), Saṃskārak.; Kull.
सम्-˚मार्जित mfn. well swept or scoured, MBh.; Hariv.
removed, destroyed, Rājat.
सम्-मार्ष्टि f. cleansing, purification, L.
सम्-˚मर्दन m. N. of a son of Vasu-deva, BhP.
of a king of the Vidyā-dharas, Kathās.
सम्-˚मर्दन n. rubbing, friction, Siṃhās.
सम्-˚मर्दिन् mfn. pressing thoroughly, rubbing, crushing, Bhaṭṭ.
सम्-˚मर्शिन् mfn. able to judge, TUp.
साम—रथंतर n. N. of a Sāman (said to have been created from Brahmā's mouth), MW.
साम—राग m. a tune or air of the S˚, Pāṇ. v, 2, 130, Sch.
साम—राज m. N. of a king and various authors (also with दीक्षित), Cat.
साम—राज n. N. of a Sāman, Lāṭy.
साम—राजन् n. N. of a S˚, PañcavBr.
सामराधिप mfn. together with the lords of the gods, R.
सामरिक mfn. (fr. सम्-अर) belonging to war or battle, martial, warlike, MW.
सामरेय mfn. (fr. id.) g. सख्य्-आदि.
सामर्घ्य n. (fr. सम्-अर्घ) cheapness, VarBṛS.
सामर्थ्य—बन्धन mfn. having power as a bond of union, cemented by or contingent on power or fitness, MW.
सामर्थ्य—योग See above.
सामर्थ्य—वत् mfn. having power or strength, capable, MBh.
सामर्थ्य—हीन mfn. destitute of strength, weak, feeble, Hit.
सामर्षम् (अम्), ind. angrily, Mṛcch.
सामर्ष—ता f. angry impatience, wrath, Ragh.
सामर्ष—हासम् ind. with an ironical smile or laugh, MW.
सामर्षण m. pl. N. of a family of Brāhmans (v.l. अघ-म्˚), VP.
साम्मार्जिन n. (fr. सम्-मार्जिन्), Pāṇ. v, 4, 15, Sch.
